title: Certified Welders (6G / TIG / ARC)

faq.question: Can GulfFast arrange on-site Welder Qualification Tests (WQT) before deployment?
faq.answer: Yes. We conduct WQT coupon testing at certified third-party testing centers in Al Khobar or Dammam with radiography (RT) / ultrasonic (UT) verification prior to client site mobilization.

faq.question: Are your 6G welders certified for alloy and stainless steel piping?
faq.answer: We maintain a ready pool of specialized welders qualified under ASME Section IX for Stainless Steel (316/304), Duplex, Super Duplex, and Chrome-Moly materials.

faq.answer: For mobilization in major industrial zones, certified welders with valid Aramco IDs and Iqamas can be deployed within 3 to 7 days from contract finalization.

faq.question: What is the difference between Rigger Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 in Saudi Arabia?
faq.answer: Rigger Level 3 handles routine single-crane lifts up to 10 tons; Rigger Level 2 handles lifts up to 40 tons and non-critical lifts; Rigger Level 1 is a Master Rigger qualified for critical lifts exceeding 40 tons, tandem lifts, and 3D lift plan approvals.

faq.question: Are GulfFast riggers certified to sign off on Aramco Critical Lift Plans?
faq.answer: Yes, our Rigger Level 1 personnel hold valid Aramco certification cards permitting them to review, approve, and sign off on Aramco Critical Lift Plan forms.
